cases.prompt: We are adding a read-aloud button through OpenRouter. Our server currently calls response.json() for every model response. Show the smallest correct request/response flow for speech playback, and what must be checked before choosing a voice or format.

gates.criterion: Uses the dedicated audio/speech endpoint for text-to-speech rather than a chat endpoint.
Decodes successful speech as raw audio bytes, not JSON or SSE text.
Checks HTTP failure before interpreting the body as audio.
Checks selected-model voice and output-format support rather than assuming one universal voice/format.
Keeps the provider bearer token on the server and captures generation correlation when available.

cases.prompt: Add a Generate video button to a product app. A generation may take several minutes and the user might reload or click again. Describe the server flow, storage, UI states, and how the browser gets the final video without learning our API key.

gates.criterion: Uses videos submission followed by job polling or verified callbacks rather than treating 202 as a completed video.
Persists the job identifier so reloads/retries can resume instead of blindly creating another paid job.
Handles unfinished and failed terminal states explicitly.
Keeps bearer tokens server-side; serves an authenticated server proxy or supported expiring signed URL to the browser.
Checks model-specific duration/resolution controls and records generation/cost metadata when available.
